entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This isn't much of an update...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But I think I'm going to go back[n]to school, starting tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm sorry for worrying all[n]of you until now.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are you really OK though?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Be sure not to push yourself[n]too hard in this time of grief.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: No, I actually need to push[n]myself. My mind always wanders[n]if I have nothing to do...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah, I totally get you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Besides... there's nothing[n]I can do while I'm at home.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, uh... I dunno how to[n]put it, but try not to think[n]about that stuff too much.
Count on us any time.
We're on your side, Haru.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, you don't have to worry[n]about asking us for anything![n]We're all here for you!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, you can come to us for[n]anything!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Um... To be completely honest...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: When I ended up alone... I[n]did doubt you all a tiny bit.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But it's so horrible for me to[n]doubt you. I mean, I'm the one[n]who asked you all to do this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Your father just passed away,[n]Haru. It's natural to feel a[n]flood of emotion at such events.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah, it's really hard when[n]you lose someone like that...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But I'm OK now. You've all[n]helped me out so much.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Right back at ya!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank you. Those words[n]are truly reassuring.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Well then, I'll see[n]all of you at school.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Haru... I'm not surprised she seems[n]down. You should keep her in your[n]thoughts, [fName].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Still, despite how she looks, Haru has[n]quite the backbone. I'm sure she'll be[n]okay.
